newsitem.title: UK: UK Labour lead falls seven points in opinion poll.
newsitem.headline: UK Labour lead falls seven points in opinion poll.

text.p: The opposition Labour Party's lead over the ruling Conservatives has fallen seven points over 24 hours, Britain's Daily Telegraph newspaper said on the eve of the national election.
The Gallup poll put support for Labour at 46 percent, down five points from Wednesday, while the Conservatives were up two points to 33.
The result contrasted with an NOP poll for Reuters earlier on Wednesday, which gave Labour a 22-point lead over the Conservatives.
A Harris poll for Thursday's Independent newspaper gave Labour a 17-point lead.
The Daily Telegraph said the poll it released late on Wednesday would be updated before the final edition of Thursday's newspaper was printed.
Opinion polls have consistently given Labour a double-digit lead throughout the six-week election campaign. The Conservatives have been in power for the past 18 years.
